question: Which offerings must be presented next using the rūpi mantra?
premises: Scents and related items are offered
The rūpi mantra governs the offering
inference: Then one should have scents and so on, along with incense and lamp, offered with the rūpi mantra.
uncertainties: rūpiṇā taken as a mantra name following tradition
plain_english: Then one should cause offerings beginning with scents, and incense and lamp, to be given with the rūpi mantra.
